label: Rewind Backward
depicts: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number five centered inside the ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer marked with the number five.
avoid_when: Do not use for other rewind counts when the centered number five is the key difference.

label: Rewind Backward
depicts: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number ten centered inside the ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a rewind timer marked with the number ten.
avoid_when: Do not use for the other rewind counts when the centered number ten must remain visible.

label: Rewind Backward
depicts: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number fifteen centered inside the ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the rewind timer variant marked with fifteen.
avoid_when: Do not use for the five ten or thirty variants when the number fifteen matters.

label: Rewind Backward
depicts: Circular rewind arrow outline with the number thirty centered inside the ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants the largest rewind timer in this circular ring family.
avoid_when: Do not use for the lower rewind counts when the number thirty must stay visible.

label: Back
depicts: Left hooked return arrow with a straight lower line and rounded outer bend
use_when: Use when the interface wants a plain back or return arrow rather than a numbered media rewind icon.
avoid_when: Do not use for circular rewind timers when the icon should stay as one simple return arrow.
